import pandas as pd

# Load the superhero data
df = pd.read_csv('csv/superhero.csv')

# Filter for female superheroes (gender_id = 2)
female_superheroes = df[df['gender_id'] == 2]

# Calculate average weight, handling missing values
avg_weight = female_superheroes['weight_kg'].mean()

print(f"Number of female superheroes: {len(female_superheroes)}")
print(f"Average weight: {avg_weight}")
